notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Turnabout.
Cast Rootha by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Resolve the copy of Turnabout, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Repeat from step 3.
